name: toolchain
description: Repo-agnostic polyglot verification toolchain: build + test + lint for changed files across .NET, Python, TypeScript, Bash, PowerShell, Markdown, Go, YAML, and cross-cutting surfaces (`/toolchain:check`, `/toolchain:lint` with format-only `--fix` and gated `--code-fix`), a re-runnable `/toolchain:setup` that reports or writes the tracked per-ecosystem command config those skills resolve first, and `/toolchain:ratchet`, a checked-in CI ceiling on a count.

turn_end_result_gate.title: Turn-end result gate
turn_end_result_gate.description: What a turn end does when the tree's recorded check or lint result is not a pass: advisory (default) warns and blocks nothing, enforce also blocks once on a recorded FAIL, off stays silent. Honored from user or managed settings only.
